selection.selection_rule: performance first: four-seed E200 0.5 sourceV+0.5 worstsourceRX;exact ties V thenworstRX;costs secondary only after equalperformance

learning_analysis_scope.train_CE: Unweighted mean of 50 training-batch mean CEs: 49 batches of 128 and one of 28; train mode.
learning_analysis_scope.V_CE: Sample mean over all 27000 source-validation samples; eval mode.
learning_analysis_scope.CE_gap: V_CE minus train_CE within each seed; different data, averaging and modes; not an error-rate gap.
learning_analysis_scope.aggregation: Four model seeds, arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1); shared data, not four independent datasets.
learning_analysis_scope.gradient: All 200 epoch means of 50 measured step norms over the complete added crosspath relation branch. No raw-step extrema or component-specific gradients available in this artifact.
learning_analysis_scope.outputs: E200 last training batch of 28 packets; not full-source or channel-causal evidence.
learning_analysis_scope.relation: Observed relation outputs do not establish transmitter-specific information, physical channel removal or causal disentanglement. Lag pairs use the shared behavior-index window 8 through 63 and 56 pairs for every lag. Rank 16 is an architecture upper bound, not a measured matrix/feature rank.
learning_analysis_scope.norms: projection_norm is the final 16-to-320 weight Frobenius norm; compress_norm is the 384-to-16 weight Frobenius norm. Each lag relation norm is the packet mean Frobenius norm of its normalized 2-by-8-by-8 complex-pair statistic.
learning_analysis_scope.floors: Measured fraction of powers below 1e-6, separately for each path and lag: whole projected branch for gram, each projected channel for coherence. Different normalization denominators must not be pooled.
